transcript.text: Hello, I'm calling from Mumbai Bank. Am I speaking to Rakesh Sharma?
Haan haan theek hai. Who is this again? I didn't quite catch that.

Thank you for confirming. I am calling from Mumbai Bank. 

I wanted to remind you that your credit card payment was due on 15th October. Your minimum amount due is 4,820 rupees. That includes interest, and a late payment fee of 750 rupees. Your total outstanding bill is 18,420 rupees.
Sorry, can you say that again? What is this 'minimum amount due'? I don't really understand.

The minimum amount due is the smallest payment you must make to keep your account in good standing. For you, that amount is 4,820 rupees. 

Do you have any other questions about your bill?
Haan haan theek hai. So, I just pay 4,820 rupees? Is that right?

Yes, you can pay 4,820 rupees to cover the minimum amount due. But your total outstanding bill is 18,420 rupees. 

By when will you be able to make the payment?
Hmm, let me see. Can I pay by next Friday? What date is that?
Next Friday is 6th November. How much will you pay then?
Okay, 6th November. Umm, I will pay 4,820 rupees on that day. Haan haan theek hai.
